raw.description: Add an element — or a whole NESTED subtree — under a parent. One call builds a complete section: pass children rather than calling this once per node.

force.description: Override a render-inference guard; reported as forced

raw.name: sb_add

raw.description: Call an operation from sb_api_find (id), or a route the catalog lacks (method+path); dry run by default. pick selects fields, max_items caps lists, item_offset skips items. Lists over 60 KB say so.

dry_run.description: Defaults to true. Pass false to actually send.

item_offset.description: Offset within this response, after API paging. Reads only.

method.description: With path, when id is absent: GET|HEAD|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE

path.description: Bare platform path, e.g. "/api/sites/{siteId}/published"; {siteId} defaults to SB_SITE

raw.name: sb_api_call

raw.description: Find API operations by intent (query), or get a call sheet (id): parameters, credential, body fields and handler caveats. Reaches all 560 operations.

id.description: An id from a previous search — returns that operation's full call sheet

query.description: What you want to do, in words: "create a menu", "list orders", "upload media"

raw.name: sb_api_find

raw.description: Bind a node to real store data so the page shows actual products, not placeholder text. action makes a button a purchase control.

force.description: Override a render-inference guard; reported as forced

source.description: e.g. article.author, article.categories, article.content, article.date; 79 in all, and a wrong one is refused with the list

raw.name: sb_bind

raw.description: Find an element type by what it does — or OMIT query to browse every type, the only way to meet one you would not have searched for. detail:true adds the AI hints, as does sb_traits_for.

detail.description: Include useWhen / avoidWhen / contentTips per match

raw.name: sb_catalog_search

raw.description: Log in and list the sites this account can operate. Call this first. Reads SB_EMAIL and SB_PASSWORD from the environment unless you pass them.
raw.name: sb_connect

raw.description: Copy a node and everything under it, under fresh ids, right after the original. The move a designer makes constantly — build one card, duplicate it twice.

force.description: Override a render-inference guard; reported as forced

raw.name: sb_duplicate

raw.description: Give a node a click action — open the cart, go to a page, open a pop-up. A purchase is not one: use sb_bind action.

action.description: An action this element allows, or "none" to clear. A wrong one is refused with the list

force.description: Override a render-inference guard; reported as forced

raw.name: sb_event

raw.description: Read a page from any public URL and add its structure and content to the OPEN page as real elements, styled with this page's own tokens. Not a clone: the source's layout and CSS are not copied. Dry run returns what was found.

max_images.description: Default 24 — every image is an upload

max_nodes.description: No cap by default — bounds the whole import if given

nav_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for a page to answer at all. Default 30000; raise it for a slow origin

upload_images.description: Copy the images into this site's media library, default true

raw.name: sb_import

raw.description: Read a WHOLE site from one URL — its sitemap, or the links on that page — and give each page found its own DRAFT page here, built from this site's tokens. Not a clone. Dry run returns the page list before anything is created.

homepage.description: Entry into this site's home page, default true

max_nodes.description: Per page. No cap by default

nav.description: Shared header linking the new pages, default true

nav_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for a page to answer at all. Default 30000; raise it for a slow origin

theme.description: Patch this site's theme from the entry page's colours and type scale, default true — SITE-WIDE, affecting pages outside this import too

raw.name: sb_import_site

raw.description: Join the site's live-edit room as a visible peer: every write then appears in any open editor as it happens, with the agent shown by the API key's own name rather than a person's. Always yields, so it is safe beside a human. Works with SB_TOKEN or with SB_EMAIL / SB_PASSWORD.
raw.name: sb_live_join

raw.description: Save, render through the platform's own renderer, and return screenshots at desktop, tablet and mobile widths, measured boxes for the bands and their children, and any layout defect measured on the render (overflow, overlap, unreadable text). node_id frames one element. Judge your work from these, not from memory.

box_depth.description: Boxes down to this depth in the tree (default 2: bands and their children)

format.description: jpeg (default) is smaller and faster; png for pixel-exact colour

node_id.description: Frame just this node instead of the whole page — how a designer looks at one card

url.description: Shoot this address instead of the draft preview — use the PUBLISHED storefront URL to see real store data

raw.name: sb_look

raw.description: The site's media library. Reuse an image before adding another; search by name, filter by type, page with limit/offset.
raw.name: sb_media_list

raw.description: Put an image into the media library and get its URL back, ready for sb_set. Takes a local path, a URL, or a SEARCH — `query` returns real photographs with their own descriptions, and `pick` uploads the one you chose, or several at once to stock a site you just built. The only way to add an image.

pick.description: The id of the search result to upload — or several ids, which stocks a site in one call

query.description: Search real photographs; read the descriptions, then pick

raw.name: sb_media_upload

raw.description: Move a node to another parent at an index.

force.description: Override a render-inference guard; reported as forced

raw.name: sb_node_read

raw.description: The open page as a compressed tree — id, type, name, child count, band, and whether a node is a shared global or a site overlay. Never the raw document: a real page is hundreds of KB of JSON.
raw.name: sb_outline

raw.description: A store type (product, category, search, blog, post, complete) arrives with the document the editor gives a merchant — product carries the whole bound buy box; seed:false for blank. Any other type is empty and sb_page_open seeds its ROOT. TYPE is the route: /checkout and /products/{slug} need a PUBLISHED page of that type or they 404.

chrome.description: Carry the site's header and footer, default true

locale.description: vi (default) or en — the complete page's wording.

seed.description: Default true; false creates a blank page.

type.description: page (default); sb_page_list lists every type and where each is served

raw.name: sb_page_create

raw.description: Every page on the site, with its slug and whether it is live.
raw.name: sb_page_list

raw.description: Open a page for editing and return its outline. Call before any sb_add / sb_set / sb_move / sb_remove. Find page ids with sb_api_find "list pages".
raw.name: sb_page_open

raw.description: Which of this page's three copies is which: the DRAFT the editor canvas shows, the PUBLISHED row the storefront serves, and what this session holds. Says whether the editor will render the canvas BLANK (its hydrate gate discards a document whose root is missing and shows an empty ROOT, silently — the Go renderer has no such gate, which is how "the live page has data but the canvas is empty" happens), whether the draft has changes the live page does not, and where the recovery points are.
raw.name: sb_page_state

raw.description: Compile the draft into the live page, and report which revision went live (id, publishedAt, fromVersionId). PUBLISH CASCADES: a page sharing a global section with others republishes them too, because a header edited once must not go live on one page and stay stale on the rest. verify:true then fetches the live page and says whether the origin is serving that revision yet — the storefront caches for 60s, so a reload showing the old page is that, not a failed publish.

verify.description: Fetch the live page afterwards and report whether it serves this revision

raw.name: sb_publish

raw.description: Remove a node and its whole subtree.

force.description: Override a render-inference guard; reported as forced

raw.name: sb_remove

raw.description: What a VISITOR would meet on the open page (blank band, placeholder, dead binding) AND what stands between this store and a paid order (checkout page, gateway, delivery, a way back to the cart). Run it before calling a page finished.
raw.name: sb_review

raw.description: Write style, config or specials keys on one node, or on many through edits (one save, one live frame). Per BREAKPOINT by default; base:true writes the fallback layer, right for a value that should not vary.

force.description: Override a render-inference guard; reported as forced

state.description: An interaction state — "hover", or "stuck" for how a pinned element looks once it is stuck (needs a sticky/fixed self-or-ancestor; a descendant styles itself through the host).

unset.description: Keys to REMOVE from the same slot — the only way to undo a write. Setting null is not the same: null is a stored value, so the override still counts as present.

raw.name: sb_set

raw.description: List the sites this account can operate.
raw.name: sb_site_list

raw.description: Run a store flow that must happen in a fixed order. action:"checkout" makes the order form, configures it, saves its fields with this store's real payment and delivery options, then creates and PUBLISHES the checkout page — /checkout 404s without all four. action:"form" seeds any of the platform's other form templates (login, register, forgot, reset, verify, contact, subscribe, booking, review and more) with its own field document, which is the part that cannot be guessed. action:"chrome" gives every page ONE shared header, built from the pages this site already has — the gap sb_review reports as siteChrome. action:"menu" binds a menu node on the open page to the site's menu and resolves its links, the way the editor does. action:"overlay_attach" puts a pop-up on the open page (kind:"popup") or points a list-dataset at a quick-view panel (kind:"quickview", list_id), creating either from the platform's own seed when overlay_id is omitted, and re-reads the page afterwards as the editor must. action:"app" installs one of the platform's built-in apps (app_key) and creates the pages it needs that installing it does not — today only "courses" has any, from the platform's own scaffold; every other key installs with nothing further to build. action:"global_attach" puts an EXISTING shared section (global_id) on the open page and action:"global_detach" takes it off, writing the reference the platform reads and placing it in the band ROOT's child order demands — the answer for a page that is missing the site's header, where action:"chrome" would wrongly build a second one. Dry run returns the plan.

app_key.description: action:"app" — which built-in app to install

footer.description: action:"chrome" — build a shared FOOTER instead of a header

global_id.description: action:"global_attach"/"global_detach" — the shared section; omitted on attach it lists the site's own

kind.description: action:"overlay_attach" — which kind of overlay to attach

list_id.description: action:"overlay_attach" kind:"quickview" — the list-dataset node on the open page

name.description: action:"form" — the form's name in the merchant's list. action:"overlay_attach" with no overlay_id — the new pop-up/quick-view's name.

node_id.description: action:"menu" — the menu node on the open page

overlay_id.description: action:"overlay_attach" — an existing overlay; omit to create one from the seed

template.description: action:"form" — which of the platform's own form templates to seed

raw.name: sb_store

raw.description: Instantiate a section template into a page — the site's own (the server copies it) or one of the BUILT-IN layouts sb_templates lists, which are composed against this page's own tokens rather than copied.
raw.name: sb_template_use

raw.description: The store's saved section templates — designed sections a person starts from rather than assembling one. Use sb_template_use to drop one into the open page.
raw.name: sb_templates

raw.description: The site's palette and type scale — the layer every element's style preset resolves from, so one token repaints every page at once. Call it with nothing to read what the site actually has. `colors` and `text_styles` PATCH the saved document: what you do not name is kept.

text_styles.description: Text style slug -> base declarations, e.g. { "h1": { "fontSize": "48px" } }

raw.name: sb_theme

raw.description: This element's INSPECTOR, as a person sees it: tabs, groups, and every control name — with what each DECLARED control writes, and the AI hints for using the element. Read this before styling an element; pass control to read one control in full.
raw.name: sb_traits_for

raw.description: Put back what a PUT through sb_api_call replaced — settings, a product, a form, anything with a shape. IN THIS PROCESS ONLY, capped, and gone when it exits. For a PAGE the platform keeps its own: GET .../pages/{pageId}/history lists the autosave checkpoint it writes on every draft save, versions lists the labelled snapshots, and either restores. That one survives everything and is the better answer whenever the thing to recover is a page. No argument lists what is undoable here.
raw.name: sb_undo
